style: Say in a friendly, youthful way, like a helpful older student
lines: Welcome to the arcade. These games were made by kids. Pick one, press Play, and watch its code light up as it runs.
Like it? Press Remix this. You get your own copy to change, and the maker still gets the credit.
This is your copy now. Click any word in a box to change it, or add a line. The original stays safe.
See the tag? What changed keeps a list of every difference from the original.
That top line is the credit. It can't be deleted. Good remixers always say whose work they built on.
Switch to Original and play it again. Same luck, same start. Is your remix different the way you wanted?
This is the original, just as it was. Same luck, same start. Is your remix different the way you wanted?
You borrowed a sprite and its code. That's combining programs. The credit line for it was added for you.
This remix has a bug. Check What changed. The bug is hiding in one of those changes.
You fixed it! Comparing with a working original is a great way to hunt bugs.
Undo goes back one change at a time, so it's safe to try wild ideas.
Ready to share? Copy your remix code, or print a card. Your credits travel with it.
Code loaded. Remember to keep their credit when you remix it.
Code loaded. This remix family is full, so you can play it but not change it.
Challenge done! It has a check mark in Challenges now.
Nothing ran for 10 seconds. Press Resume, then press a key or click a sprite to make something happen.
Hmm, that code doesn't work. Check each letter and try again.
Saved on this device.
Game over. Want to change a rule and try again?
Press Play to try your change, or tap a row in What changed to find that line in the program.
Press Play to watch the original, then press My remix to switch back.
Press Play to watch the borrowed code run.
To fix it, press Remix this. Then, in What changed, tap the row under Changes Kai made to find the line. Tap the wrong word and pick the right one.
In What changed, tap the row under Changes Kai made to find the line. Then tap the wrong word and pick the right one.
To fix it, press Remix this. Then, in What changed, tap Jay's score change to find the line in when pumpkin is clicked. Tap the number and pick a bigger one.
In What changed, tap Jay's score change to find the line in when pumpkin is clicked. Then tap the number and pick a bigger one.
Press Play to test your fix.
Press Undo again to go back one more change.
Press Play to try their game, then change any word to start your own remix.
Press Play to try their game. To make your own, pick an original in the Arcade and press Remix this.
Fix the code in the box, then press Load again.
To open it later, find it in My saved remixes and press Open.
Change a word in the program, then press Play.
Press the key buttons under the stage to play. Or click the stage, then use your keyboard.
Click a sprite on the stage to play.
Click a sprite on the stage, and use the key buttons under it or your keyboard.
Watch each line light up as it runs. Press Pause to look closer.
Press Delete to remove the event, or Keep it to leave it.
Press Remove to take the sprite out, or Keep it to leave it in.
Press Yes to go back to the original, or No to keep your changes.
Press Start new to begin a new remix, or Keep mine to go back to your changes.
Press Clear to remove them all, or Keep them to leave them saved.
The code in the box is selected. Press Ctrl and C together to copy it, or Command and C on a Mac.
Paused. Press Step to run one line at a time, or Resume to keep going.
Nothing to share yet. Pick a game in the Arcade and press Remix this.
Pick a game and press Play. Each line lights up as it runs. Like it? Press Remix this.
This is a classmate's remix. What changed lists every difference from the game it came from. Press Play to try it.
Click any word in a box to change it, or add a line. Drag a sprite on the stage to set where it starts.
This is the original, and it is read only. Press Play to watch it, then press My remix to switch back.
This remix came from a code. Your first change starts your own remix of it, and their credit stays.
This remix family is full. Start from an original: pick one in the Arcade and press Remix this.
Copy your remix code or print a card. To open a friend's remix, paste their code under Load a code.
